sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. sources.title: Temporal integration of ResNet features with LSTM for enhanced skin ...
sources.snippet: The R-LSTM50 model combines the powerful feature extraction capabilities of ResNet50 with the temporal modeling strength of LSTM networks, ensuring both high accuracy and computational efficiency. Our approach addresses the critical need for early cancer detection, where timely and precise diagnosis can significantly improve patient outcomes.
